en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions failing their first clone under Anthropic-managed git when the machine's git config has an `includeIf "gitdir:"` or (git 2.44 to 2.46) `"onbranch:"` section
zh: 修复了当机器的 git 配置包含 `includeIf "gitdir:"` 或（git 2.44 至 2.46）`"onbranch:"` 段时，自托管 runner session 在 Anthropic 托管的 git 下首次克隆失败的问题
